blogs.title: Why a Rainbow Salad Fuels Your Day
blogs.author: Ashmi Patel
blogs.description: Colourful veggies deliver a wide range of vitamins.
blogs.content: Eating a rainbow of vegetables ensures you get vitamin A, C, K, folate and fibre. Start with leafy greens, add carrots, beetroot, peppers and finish with a lemon-olive oil dressing.

blogs.title: 5 Protein-Packed Salad Bowls
blogs.author: Ranvir Chauhan
blogs.description: Build filling bowls with chickpeas, paneer and quinoa.
blogs.content: Protein keeps you full for longer. Combine quinoa, chickpeas, grilled paneer or tofu with crunchy cucumbers and a tahini drizzle for a balanced meal in 10 minutes.

blogs.title: Fresh Vegetables: Buy, Wash & Store
blogs.author: Harshil Suthar
blogs.description: Keep produce crisp and safe for longer.
blogs.content: Wash leafy greens in cold water, spin dry, and store in a box lined with a paper towel. Keep tomatoes at room temperature and cucumbers in the fridge door.

blogs.title: Light Dressings You Can Make in 2 Minutes
blogs.author: Prayash Jena
blogs.description: Skip the bottled stuff with these simple dressings.
blogs.content: Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, honey and mustard. Or blend yoghurt with mint and garlic. Store in a jar for up to five days.

blogs.title: Salmon & Greens: Omega-3 Power Salad
blogs.author: Om Kadam
blogs.description: A heart-healthy salad rich in omega-3 fats.
blogs.content: Flake baked salmon over rocket and spinach, add avocado, cherry tomatoes and a squeeze of lime. High in protein and healthy fats.

blogs.title: Fruit Salads for Summer Energy
blogs.author: Ummehani Namakwala
blogs.description: Hydrating fruit mixes with natural sweetness.
blogs.content: Combine watermelon, pomegranate, mint and a dash of chaat masala. Fruit salads are hydrating and a great post-workout snack.

blogs.title: Meal-Prep Your Salads for the Week
blogs.author: Aachal Ambaliya
blogs.description: Layer jars on Sunday and eat well all week.
blogs.content: Layer dressing first, then hard veggies, grains, protein and greens on top. Seal and refrigerate. Draft - add photos.
